detectors.name: New Event
detectors.description: Alerts when a log template that has never been seen appears — an unexpected type of event in the environment.

detectors.name: Event Sequence
detectors.description: Alerts when consecutive events occur in an order never observed during training — even when each event is benign on its own.

detectors.name: SCVS
detectors.description: Sequence Count Vector Set. Alerts on event count vectors that were not present in the training data.

detectors.name: ECVC
detectors.description: Event Count Vector Clustering. Scores new count vectors by their distance from the ones seen in training.

detectors.name: DeepLog
detectors.description: Deep-learning sequence model based on the DeepLog paper.

detectors.name: LogBERT
detectors.description: Transformer-based model based on the LogBERT paper.

detectors.name: New Value
detectors.description: Alerts when a configured field takes a value it has never had before, such as a new user name, IP address or process.

detectors.name: New Value Combo
detectors.description: Alerts when values that are each familiar appear together in a combination that has never been seen.

detectors.name: Value Range
detectors.description: Alerts when a numeric field falls outside the range it has been observed in.

detectors.name: Charset
detectors.description: Alerts when characters that have never been seen appear in a configured field.

detectors.name: Bigram Frequency
detectors.description: Alerts when the character pairs in a value are improbable under a learned per-field bigram model, with an optional English-language fallback.

detectors.name: Rule
detectors.description: Raises alerts based on a configurable set of rules.

detectors.name: Random
detectors.description: Emits synthetic alerts at a configurable rate. Use it for integration and load testing, or as the floor every other detector has to beat.
